git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fix cache corruption on concurrent writes

Cache files were written with fs::write(), which truncates before
writing. Concurrent installations racing on the same cache key
could read a partially-written or empty file. Introduce
sys::atomic_write() that writes to a temp file then renames,
ensuring readers always see complete content. Applied to
CacheStore, CacheRevalidator, and RemoteFetcher.

Also fix pre-existing clippy warnings (sort_by_key,
collapsible_match, checked_div).
EOF
